title: до, после, около, мимо, кроме, вместо, против…

blocks.text: Prepositions followed by the genitive case

rows: before, till, until, to, up to

blocks.text: From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 60.

The exercises are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. The word in brackets is the dictionary form of the missing word.

exercises.prompt: Tom left before the concert ended.
exercises.why: «List of prepositions which are followed by the genitive case: без, вдоль, вместо, для, до, из, из-за, из-под, кроме, мимо, около, от, после, против, с, у.» — DLI, Lesson 60.
